text: OVERDOSAGE In cases of suspected salicylate toxicity, the use of 6% Salicylic Acid Gel should be discontinued, and the patient should be monitored closely for signs of: nausea, vomiting, dizziness, loss of hearing, tinnitus, lethargy, hyperpnoea, diarrhea, psychic disturbances. Call your local poison control center and/or your doctor if overdosage is suspected.
